description: This file defines a React functional component 'LessonPracticeScreen' for a mobile app. It manages state for lesson data and user answers, fetches lesson details on mount, and renders UI elements for short writing practice, including a prompt, input box, and buttons for submitting and navigating back.

methods.name: LessonPracticeScreen
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the lesson practice screen, managing lesson data retrieval, answer input, feedback, and navigation.
